machineNotes: This is a Linux runner. Use the playwright MCP tools for the browser (a real Chromium on a virtual display). For each job call get_resume with the job title; the chosen file is in ./resumes/<filename> in your current directory (fallback: ./Preston_Zen_Resume_AI_2026-10-08.pdf). Upload that file and ignore the Windows path in the playbook. This machine has helpers for the two things that used to block you. (1) CAPTCHA/bot check (e.g. Cloudflare Turnstile on Greenhouse): run `node /opt/job-agent-runner/captcha-solve.mjs --url <current page url>` in the shell, then apply the returned token in the page with browser_evaluate following the JSON's `inject` instructions, then continue. (2) Greenhouse emailed a login/2FA code: run `node /opt/job-agent-runner/gmail-code.mjs --wait 120` in the shell and type the returned code into the form. If a helper is missing its credentials, errors, or the check still fails after 2 attempts, report needs_human with the details.
